'''Harrower assassins''', or '''Harrowers''' as they were more commonly known, were grotesque [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] abominations created from [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] by the [[Sith sorcerer]] [[Fulminiss]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] kept several Harrowers on his [[Emperor's Fortress|space station]] as guards. During the final days of the Cold War, a trio of Harrowers were sent to assassinate the Jedi [[Jomar Chul]] after he had obtained map data pinpointing the Emperor's space station's location. The Harrowers successfully shot down [[Jomar Chul's ship|Jomar's vessel]] over Tatooine, but were intercepted at the crash site and subsequently killed by the Hero of Tython.
